description: This file defines a FastAPI web server for a Tic Tac Toe backend API, including data models and endpoint contracts for starting/resetting the game, making moves, and querying game state. It contains no implemented logic, only interface definitions.

classes.name: BoardModel
classes.description: Represents the Tic Tac Toe board as a 3x3 grid.

classes.name: MoveModel
classes.description: Represents a move request from client.

classes.name: GameResultModel
classes.description: Represents the result state of the current game.

classes.name: GameStateModel
classes.description: Represents the entire current state of the game.

methods.name: start_or_reset_game()
methods.description: Starts a new Tic Tac Toe game or resets the current one.

methods.name: make_move(move: MoveModel)
methods.description: Plays a move for the given player at the specified position.

methods.name: get_game_state()
methods.description: Returns the current state of the game, including the board, current player, and game result status.
